digest.component_or_area: create coordination and outbound dispatch routing
propositions: Process restart must converge to exactly one remote issue and one confirmed binding without duplicate creation
Create routing is governed by a single selector (create_route.create_route) with COORDINATOR_ROUTE as default and LEGACY_ROUTE as rollback, ensuring no dual-send across three live consumers
Links and children are held until create and binding confirmation are proven, while tombstones, filters, and read-only modes remain effective
Keyed recovery performs zero search; keyless recovery requires both three misses and 3600 seconds before timing out
Per-entry recovery failure must not block unrelated tickets from processing

Coordinated create core adapts its outcome to create_one's contract: return create dict on confirmed, re-raise original exception on failure, emit BRIDGE_ALERT on landed-unconfirmed, defer on commit-unknown
